timeline.title: Adani Power reports Q2 today
timeline.line: Stock eases about 1.2% to ₹185 ahead of the numbers
more: June-quarter net profit was ₹4,105.43 cr on ₹16,427 cr total income
Year-ago Q2 profit after tax was ₹2,906 cr

src.title: Kotak Neo: Adani Power announces Q2 FY27 results on 23 October
